shortDescription: Manage Server Profile Templates in Cisco Intersight

options.name: adapter_policy
options.description: Name of Adapter Configuration Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: api_bearer_token
options.description: Bearer token for OAuth2 authentication with the Intersight API. When provided, I(api_key_id) and I(api_private_key) are not required and the C(cryptography) Python library is not needed. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_BEARER_TOKEN environment variable is used.

options.name: api_key_id
options.description: Public API Key ID associated with the private key. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_KEY_ID environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_private_key
options.description: Filename (absolute path) or string of PEM formatted private key data to be used for Intersight API authentication. If a string is used, Ansible vault should be used to encrypt string data. Ex. ansible-vault encrypt_string --vault-id tme@/Users/dsoper/Documents/vault_password_file '-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----     <your private key data>     -----END EC PRIVATE KEY-----' If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable is used. Required if I(api_bearer_token) is not

options.name: api_uri
options.description: URI used to access the Intersight API. If not set, the value of the INTERSIGHT_API_URI environment variable is used.

options.name: bios_policy
options.description: Name of BIOS Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: boot_order_policy
options.description: Name of Boot Order Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: certificate_policy
options.description: Name of Certificate Management Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: description
options.description: The user-defined description of the Server Profile Template. Description can contain letters(a-z, A-Z), numbers(0-9), hyphen(-), period(.), colon(:), or an underscore(_).

options.name: device_connector_policy
options.description: Name of Device Connector Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: drive_security_policy
options.description: Name of Drive Security Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: firmware_policy
options.description: Name of Firmware Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: ipmi_over_lan_policy
options.description: Name of IPMI over LAN Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: lan_connectivity_policy
options.description: Name of LAN Connectivity Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: ldap_policy
options.description: Name of LDAP Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: local_user_policy
options.description: Name of Local User Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: memory_policy
options.description: Name of Memory Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: name
options.description: The name assigned to the Server Profile Template. The name must be between 1 and 64 alphanumeric characters, allowing special characters :-_.

options.name: network_connectivity_policy
options.description: Name of Network Connectivity Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: ntp_policy
options.description: Name of NTP Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: organization
options.description: The name of the Organization this resource is assigned to. Templates and Policies that are created within a Custom Organization are applicable only to devices in the same Organization.

options.name: persistent_memory_policy
options.description: Name of Persistent Memory Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: power_policy
options.description: Name of Power Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: san_connectivity_policy
options.description: Name of SAN Connectivity Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: sd_card_policy
options.description: Name of SD Card Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: serial_over_lan_policy
options.description: Name of Serial over LAN Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: smtp_policy
options.description: Name of SMTP Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: snmp_policy
options.description: Name of SNMP Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: ssh_policy
options.description: Name of SSH Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: state
options.description: If C(present), will verify the resource is present and will create if needed. If C(absent), will verify the resource is absent and will delete if needed.

options.name: storage_policy
options.description: Name of Storage Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: syslog_policy
options.description: Name of Syslog Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: tags
options.description: List of tags in Key:<user-defined key> Value:<user-defined value> format.

options.name: target_platform
options.description: The platform for which the server profile template is applicable. C(standalone) for servers operating in Standalone mode. C(fi-attached) for servers attached to a Fabric Interconnect managed by Intersight. C(unified-edge) for Unified Edge servers.

options.name: thermal_policy
options.description: Name of Thermal Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean control for verifying the api_uri TLS certificate

options.name: virtual_kvm_policy
options.description: Name of Virtual KVM Policy to associate with this template.

options.name: virtual_media_policy
options.description: Name of Virtual Media Policy to associate with this template.
